Initial release of the Public Opinion Report skill.

- Allows generating public opinion analysis reports by calling the Midu-Public-Opinion-Report interface.
- Supports multiple types of reports, including incident, topic, industry, activity, periodic, and more.
- Requires a MIDU_API_KEY to access the reporting service.
- Provides command-line usage and parameter guidance for integrating report requests.
- Includes example commands and report type explanations for quick reference.
